answer.text:
Choosing the right ERP for real estate depends on whether your focus is real estate development (construction milestones, contractor management, job costing) or property portfolio management (leasing, asset management, capital projects).

| Software | Best For | Key Project Tracking Features | Real Estate Specifics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sage 300 CRE** | Mid-to-Large Developers & Builders | Job costing, change order management, subcontracts, commitment tracking. | Full lease administration, tenant billing, property accounting. |
| **Yardi Voyager** | Large Developers & Asset Managers | Construction management, capital project tracking, budget vs. actual monitoring. | End-to-end property lifecycle, investor management, commercial/residential leasing. |
| **Oracle NetSuite** | Growing Mid-Market & Enterprise | Gantt charts, resource allocation, real-time project profitability, milestone tracking. | Flexible core ERP requiring real estate add-ons (e.g., SuiteApps) for property leasing. |
| **Acumatica Construction Edition** | Mid-Market Developers & Contractors | Field reporting, compliance tracking, subcontracts, mobile job costing. | Integrated CRM, tenant portals, multi-entity financial consolidation. |
| **MRI Software** | Commercial & Residential Portfolio Owners | Capital project planning, job cost tracking, contractor invoice approvals. | Comprehensive lease management, CAM reconciliations, asset tracking. |

**Key Capabilities to Look For:**
* **Job Costing & Budget Controls:** Track commitments, change orders, and forecasted vs. actual costs per property or site phase.
* **Subcontractor & Vendor Management:** Streamline compliance (insurance, lien waivers) and purchase order processing.
* **Milestone & Schedule Tracking:** Integration with tools like MS Project or Primavera to map construction timelines directly to project budgets.
* **Multi-Entity Accounting:** Ability to manage separate SPVs (Single Purpose Entities) or LLCs under one consolidated financial ledger.
